user.title: Sign in to Dots Energy
user.description: Use the e-mail address and password of the Dots customer portal.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Dots Energy again
reauth_confirm.description: Dots no longer accepts the stored login. Enter your password again.

captcha.title: Dots asks for a captcha
captcha.description: Dots shows a captcha on its login page, so Home Assistant cannot sign in automatically. Use a refresh token instead, or try again later.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Open a private browser window, sign in at https://my.dotsenergy.be, open the developer tools (F12) → Application → Session Storage → https://my.dotsenergy.be → the key starting with oidc.user: and copy the value of refresh_token. Close that window afterwards and do not use that session again.

location.title: Delivery address
location.description: Your account has several delivery addresses. Pick the one to follow.

error.invalid_auth: Dots did not accept this login.
error.cannot_connect: Dots could not be reached. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected answer from Dots. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Dots account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different Dots account than the one set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Dots could not be reached. Try again later.
abort.no_locations: No delivery address found on this Dots account.
